name: CySOC_DCSync_Respond
author: CySOC
description: Evaluate a DCSync case against the user+host whitelist stored in Consul KV. Stable identifiers (Microsoft Defender device id, directory object id) are read from the MicrosoftDefender enrichment analyzer reports attached to the observables, so any spelling of the same user/host matches the same whitelist entry. All pairs whitelisted: closes the case as a false positive. Any pair not whitelisted: optionally disables the user's Entra account and/or isolates the source device (only the non-whitelisted user/device pairs), then closes the case as a true positive only if every attempted action succeeded — otherwise the case is left open. Fails without closing when an observable lacks enrichment. The decision is always logged to a 'CySOC/Log' task on the case.

configurationItems.name: thehive_api_key
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with permission to read observables and close cases

configurationItems.name: consul_kv_whitelist
configurationItems.description: Exact Consul KV path to the whitelist key (a single key holding a YAML document, not a directory prefix). Leave empty to skip the whitelist check — every pair is then treated as not whitelisted (true positive, case stays open)

configurationItems.name: close_on_fp
configurationItems.description: Close the case automatically when every user+host pair is whitelisted

configurationItems.name: tenant_id
configurationItems.description: Azure AD tenant id. Required only if disable_user_on_tp or isolate_device_on_tp is enabled

configurationItems.name: client_id
configurationItems.description: Azure AD app registration (client) id, granted Microsoft Graph 'User.EnableDisableAccount.All' + 'User.Read.All' and a Defender for Endpoint machine-action permission (e.g. 'Machine.Isolate'). Required only if disable_user_on_tp or isolate_device_on_tp is enabled

configurationItems.name: client_secret
configurationItems.description: Client secret for the app registration above. Required only if disable_user_on_tp or isolate_device_on_tp is enabled

configurationItems.name: disable_user_on_tp
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, disable the Entra account of every non-whitelisted user via Microsoft Graph

configurationItems.name: isolate_device_on_tp
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, isolate every non-whitelisted source device via Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

configurationItems.name: full_isolation
configurationItems.description: Isolation scope for isolate_device_on_tp: false (default, recommended) isolates Selectively; true performs a Full network isolation. Ignored unless isolate_device_on_tp is enabled
